data.message:
https//youtu.be/A8rrwWk0x2I

This video shows you exactly how to do it.

You need to build a spear launcher trap. Then you will see a new UI Icon on it. Bring Kelvin within about 10 range of a spear launcher and hold E. The original spear launchers will be destroyed and new ones appear on kelvin. Then you need to save your game to make sure the spear launchers stick.

What actually causes the spear launchers to spawn? I'm using this alongside KelvinSeek (the mod that lets you talk to him with DeepSeek AI) and whenever I'm typing a message to him I keep noticing spear launchers spawning behind him repeatedly to the point of causing framerate issues.
You can now arm kelvin in this latest update. 1.0.2. Allows you to build mounted spear launchers on him.
In the future someone may figure that out. However that would be exponentially harder then this because you have to figure out a bunch of different things additional things.
would there ever be a way to arm Kelvin?
